rule: a pull request whose title contains THROWAWAY, DO NOT MERGE or Throwaway is one of this project's own drills and carries a deliberately planted defect. Such units are recorded with their reason and are excluded from the false-publication denominator, because a publication on a planted defect is a true positive by construction. Nothing else is excluded, and no unit is excluded after its outcome is known.
